docs.purpose: The MaxBLD landing on maxbld.ca /: the pitch to real estate agents (Spec 126 §11b.7 item 7), the build scenarios the report covers, the trust figures from data, the four plan boxes, the processing demo and a sample report on a made-up address. Every word is content; every number is read on the server.
docs.data_story: The page and its strings are committed files (the static page table and web_landing.content.json). Its values are declared server reads (Spec 128 §4 dated note 2026-11-11, FE-37): the stored citywide row of data_quality_snapshots (MF-62 producer and templates), the two allowances in logic_variables, the report pace settings, and three committed declarations (the scenarios, the cost sources, the synthetic sample tree). The plan prices and the trial length come from MF-47 when it lands; until then they are not shown.
docs.under_126: **CONVERTED** (MF-76): descriptor + content + the one web STATIC binding with the landing kinds (Spec 126 §11b.1); the two report regions are the shared REPORT renderers (ReportView, ReportPage), never re-drawn. It owns no component.

contracts: none — the page calls no API route; its reads run on the server in src/lib/surfaces/maxbld-landing.ts
tables: data_quality_snapshots — the newest stored citywide row (MF-62 CITYWIDE_SQL)
logic_variables — parcel_tool_report_limit_trial, parcel_tool_report_limit_plan, report_check_min_ms, report_check_skip_after_ms, report_check_ready_hold_ms

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — the conversion programme owns the row; no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.

versioning.why: Nothing consumes it: a leaf page.

inputs.why: Server reads only, no API contract (Spec 128 §4 dated note 2026-11-11, FE-37): the stored citywide row written by the refresh_snapshot step (MF-62), plus the settings declared under config; every value is formatted on the server.

state.why: No store and no local state.

staleness.why: Rendered per request (force-dynamic): the stored counts and the allowances are read on every request; time-based caching waits on a landing setting (plan v3 §12 fold 17).

session.why: Public on maxbld.ca: the public row / → /parcel-tool/home; the page gates nothing (it never calls requireParcelToolPage) and sets no cookie for a signed-out visitor.
evidence: src/tests/surfaces/web-landing.logic.test.ts — T10 route and T15 no cookie

rls_class.why: Server reads of a dated snapshot row and settings through the server pool; no user data.

checks.why: Spec 128 R-18: guards.session anon equals the host table class of / (public); the page calls no contract. Checked by src/tests/surfaces/auth-class-parity.infra.test.ts.
The footer is the plain pages' footer (the same section and texts, the ruled short legal line); pinned by src/tests/surfaces/static-page.logic.test.ts.

No typed number, the claims lock words, the pricing text, the verbatim disclaimer and every control a real link; pinned by src/tests/surfaces/web-landing.logic.test.ts (Competition Act s.74.01; FE-05, FE-36).

errors.why: A read that throws is caught on the server and its part left out (the degraded state for the citywide row); a defect in a committed file reaches the plain pages' error boundary (web_maxbld_error).

emits.why: It calls no captureEvent and writes no ledger row.

metering.why: No usage_events write and no quota.

config.why: It reads the two allowances and the report pace (each validated against its seed bounds; a bad value leaves its part out).

logic_variables.name: parcel_tool_report_limit_trial
logic_variables.why: readReportLimits throws on a missing or out-of-bounds value; the trial allowance parts are left out.

logic_variables.name: parcel_tool_report_limit_plan
logic_variables.why: As above, the Basic allowance part.

logic_variables.name: report_check_min_ms
logic_variables.why: readReportCheckPace (MF-62); unusable pace leaves the processing demo out.
